subject: Marketplace renewal — coordinated billing cutover and staged capacity plan
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork + planned capacity ramp (GCP private offer)

Connor —

Thanks for the renewal packet you shared last week. Procurement ran the numbers and we have two asks before we can route PO internally:

1) Our finance team needs the billing cutover window documented — we want zero overlap billing (we bill monthly) and a clear start date for the new private offer charges.
2) We plan to ramp usage in phases over Q2 — want to confirm staged capacity activation (start at 0.5x for 60 days, then 1.5x) and how that maps to committed units in the private offer.

Can you send an updated SOW/acceptance guide and a sample PO we can preview? Also cc'ing procurement for their checklist.

Appreciate it —
Lena Ortiz
Head of Cloud Engineering
Nimbus Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + planned capacity ramp (GCP private offer)

Thanks, Lena — really helpful context. Quick answers up front:

• Billing cutover: we can align the private-offer billing start to your requested cutover date (we'll provide a clean 00:00 UTC start so there is no double-billing overlap). We will also emit a prorated invoice for the partial cycle, if needed.
• Staged capacity: supported — we propose a 2-tranche activation: tranche A (50% committed capacity) for first 60 days, tranche B (full committed capacity + 50% buffer) thereafter. Buffer capacity handled via burst credits so you only pay committed units unless burst consumed.

Attaching an updated private-offer PDF that maps staged capacity to PO line items, and a GCP acceptance checklist. Marissa — can you confirm if the PO language we usually provide works for Nimbus (we included the 18mo private-offer term in RDW-7892 but we can adjust). Dev — any infra constraints on phasing activation?

Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_RDW_PrivateOffer_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB); GCP-Marketplace-Acceptance-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + planned capacity ramp (GCP private offer)

Lena — thanks for the clarity. A couple of procurement notes: 

• PO sample: attaching a draft PO (PO_NIMB-5543.pdf) with line-items split by tranche (A and B) and invoice schedule. If you prefer a single PO with a billing ramp note, we can flatten it.
• Billing cadence: Redwood issues monthly invoices. For the cutover we will: (a) finalize acceptance (GCP private-offer acceptance link), (b) set start date at 2028-04-01T00:00:00Z, (c) issue a prorated invoice for 2028-04 (if acceptance happens mid-cycle). Please confirm the desired cutover date and who will sign the PO.

Connor — I'd like to reserve a clause that allows a one-time mid-term capacity increase without re-executing the private-offer (exec-approved uplift up to 20%) — will that be acceptable to Nimbus?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO_NIMB-5543.pdf (PDF, draft)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 9 Mar 2028 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + planned capacity ramp (GCP private offer)

Marissa —

Thanks, the draft PO looks solid. Quick responses: 

• Confirm cutover date: 2028-04-01T00:00:00Z works for us.
• Signing: procurement will sign the PO once we have the final SOW language and the DocuSign envelope.
• Mid-term increase clause: we like the one-time uplift option (up to 20%) — please add language around notification (30 days) and a price table for uplift tiers.

One more ask: can Redwood share the acceptance playbook for the GCP private offer so our cloud ops team can run the pre-acceptance checklist? A link or brief playbook is fine.

-Lena
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@nimbushealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + planned capacity ramp (GCP private offer)

Lena — looping in with the acceptance playbook link and a short infra note.

Acceptance playbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cPlaybookRDW (read-only)
Key infra notes:
- Tranche activation uses feature flags tied to your org-id; we can enable tranche A immediately at start date and allow a toggle to tranche B.
- Burstable credits are metered separately and will appear as a usage line-item; they do not trigger SLA changes.
- If you need a cold-start warmup (large KV-cache preload) we recommend scheduling a 2-hour warmup window during the first 48 hours after cutover.

I'll update the private-offer PDF with the 30-day notification uplift language and a simple price table; Connor/Marissa will follow up with the DocuSign envelope.

—Dev
Engineering Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: updated_PrivateOffer_with_uplift_clause.pdf (will be included in DocuSign)
